season.definition: The central activity window covers the middle 80% of detections; it is not the start or end of burning.
season.amount_caveat: Detections are not burned area, and overpass timing can change counts.
season.timing_later: The midpoint shifted {{n}} days per decade later (interval {{lo}} to {{hi}}; observed era).
season.timing_earlier: The midpoint shifted {{n}} days per decade earlier (interval {{lo}} to {{hi}}; observed era).
season.amount_more: Detections changed by {{n}}% more per decade (interval {{lo}} to {{hi}}%; observed era).
season.amount_fewer: Detections changed by {{n}}% fewer per decade (interval {{lo}} to {{hi}}%; observed era).
help.status: How this week compares with the same week in past years. A result at either extreme means the week ranks in the bottom or top tenth.
help.calendar: Each square is one week; darker means more fires detected by satellites. Rows are years. Rings mark unusual weeks.
help.bands: The shaded band is the likely range of the true weekly count (90% of the time). Before 2012 values are estimated from older satellites, so the band is wider.
help.severity: How many typical weeks’ worth of extra burning a period had.
help.drivers: Weather that tended to come before or with burning. These are associations, not proof of cause.
help.outlook: Where this season stands compared with past seasons at the same date. Forecasts are shown only where they proved accurate on past seasons.
help.sources: Observed: Suomi NPP satellite. Adjusted: NOAA-20 satellite scaled to the same standard. Modeled: estimated from older MODIS satellites (before 2012).
